invariants.rationale: It is likely required that the list of records to insert is provided (i.e., not null) at the entry of the bulk insert method.
A non-null instantTime (commit time) string is likely required to perform a bulk insert operation.
A valid engine context must be provided to the method for execution.
A Java List's size is never negative, thus this is always true if records is a valid list.
Even though Option may be empty, the object itself should not be null at the method entry to check for presence safely.
